programme.title: Instinct
programme.desc: Three fighters, one vital resource, no room for compromise. "Instinct" is a tense, physically charged short dance film built around a single life-or-death struggle. As the dancers clash over water, their movement becomes a test of endurance, urgency, and survival. Their movements are sharp, stripped-back, and unflinching. Bodies strain, collide, and resist, mirroring the brutal realities of scarcity and entitlement. Every action carries consequences, and every choice exposes what desperation can bring in each of us. With a stark visual language and urgent momentum, this is a gripping meditation on survival, power, and the cost of getting what we need.

programme.title: The Velveteen Rabbit
programme.desc: balletLORENT's adaptation delves into the universal themes of childhood innocence and the passage of time, beautifully illustrating how love and companionship shape identity and offering a heartfelt reminder of the power of connection. The story resonates with audiences of all ages, evoking memories of cherished childhood toys and the emotions attached to them. Adults will find themselves reflecting on the fleeting nature of time, while younger audiences will be enthralled by the magic of toys coming to life. At its core, The Velveteen Rabbit is a tale of hope, resilience, and the enduring power of love. balletLORENT's production captures this essence with breathtaking dance, evocative storytelling, and stunning visuals, ensuring the story's timeless message remains as powerful as ever. This emotionally moving performance is a true celebration of imagination, love, and the magic of believing—leaving audiences with a sense of wonder that lingers long after the final curtain falls.

programme.title: Tempest
programme.desc: "Tempest," starring Agnes Su of Stuttgart Ballet, is a mesmerizing dance film that captures the delicate tension between aspiration and self-acceptance. With stark simplicity and emotional honesty, Su's performance embodies the beauty and struggle of striving for perfection, revealing the quiet moments where vulnerability and grace meet. Elegant, intimate, and very moving, "Tempest" is a celebration of the artistry in imperfection and the courage it takes to dance on your own terms.

programme.title: Montreux Jazz Festival
programme.desc: A jazz legend returns to the stage where he made history. George Benson's 2013 Montreux performance is a masterclass from a true musical giant. From child prodigy to global superstar, jazz fusion icon George Benson's career has been nothing short of extraordinary. Performing in clubs by age seven and releasing radio hits by eleven, "little Georgie Benson" grew into one of the most celebrated guitarists and vocalists in jazz history. With genre-defining albums like "Breezin'" and a career spanning over 80 years, Benson has earned 10 Grammy Awards across jazz, pop, and R&B. In this unforgettable 2013 Montreux set, his 16th appearance at the festival, Benson proves why he remains one of the greatest performers of our time. Set List: Big Parade No Gettin' Over You Swimming Pools (Drank) Give me The Night Turn Your Love Around Nothing's Gonna Change My Love For You Love Dance Unforgettable Route 66 Give me The Night Beyond the Sea ( La Mer) On Broadway.

programme.title: Instinct
programme.desc: Three fighters, one vital resource, no room for compromise. "Instinct" is a tense, physically charged short dance film built around a single life-or-death struggle. programme.title: Daniel Barenboim - Beethoven: Complete Piano Sonatas: No. 29, Op. 106 Hammerklavier
programme.desc: GRAMMY Award-winning pianist and conductor Daniel Barenboim tackles the so-called "New Testament" of music, Ludwig van Beethoven's thirty-two piano sonatas. Composed over twenty-five years and embodying the shift of musical taste from the Classic to the Romantic, their performance requires a musician of extraordinary versatility. Daniel Barenboim is one such pianist - his recordings run the gamut from Bach and Mozart to Bruckner and Bartók. In following in the footsteps of such masters as Artur Schnabel, Barenboim truly shows himself to be among the greatest living musicians.

programme.title: The Coronation of King George II
programme.desc: The King's Consort is one of the world's leading period instrument choirs and orchestras. Founded in 1980 by Robert King, they have toured all five continents and have appeared in almost every European country, as well as Japan, Hong Kong and the Far East. For more than three decades, The King's Consort, under the artistic direction of Robert King, has performed a wide variety of repertoire from 1550 to the present day. Historical reconstruction of a major event, this concert benefits from the exceptional setting of the Royal Chapel of Versailles which, having never known the coronation of a king of France, will know during this exceptional evening its first coronation, English moreover.

programme.title: Sir Simon Rattle - Berliner Philharmoniker - Anderson / Dvořák / Brahms
programme.desc: Even if the music world is often dominated by rivalry, examples of genuine friendships can certainly be found. Take Johannes Brahms and Antonín Dvořák: a pair whose friendship was free of self-interest. "That fellow has more ideas than all the rest of us. Even what he tosses into the trash could serve as a main theme for anyone else," Brahms once remarked about his Czech colleague, 8 years his junior - and he didn't just stop at nice compliments. In 1877 Brahms recommended his publisher Fritz Simrock to take on Dvořák, at the time a completely unknown composer from Prague. And sure enough, his first publication, the spirited Slavonic Dances, enjoyed a sensational success. The Berlin Philharmonic paid homage to this musical friendship by pairing Dvořák's bravura score with the "summerly" Second Symphony of Brahms, also composed in 1877. And as an "appetizer" Sir Simon Rattle has commissioned a new work from his compatriot Julian Anderson, which provided a brief but substantial entrée into what followed.

programme.title: Montreux Jazz Festival
programme.desc: Captured before the breakout success of his second album, British singer-songwriter Michael Kiwanuka delivers a soulful set at the 2014 Montreux festival. From the moment he arrived on the scene in 2011, Michael Kiwanuka stood out with his rich, velvety voice and timeless songwriting. This episode of "Memory Lane" takes a look back at the artist's early career, alongside footage from his 2014 Montreux Jazz Festival set. This Montreux performance captures a pivotal moment in Kiwanuka's career as he road-tests raw, unreleased songs while crafting what would become his breakthrough album "Love & Hate." This is a front-row seat to an artist on the brink of transformation. Set List: Barrowland Ballroom I like the Way This is Going Home Again The Cave Hard to See Tell me a Tale Always Waiting May This be Love (cover) I Felt the Rain Rest Home Again Everyday Place I Belong I'll Get Along.

programme.title: Una Notte a Napoli
programme.desc: Set to music by Pink Martini, "Una Notte a Napoli" ( A Night in Napoli) is a playful and cinematic dance film that is delightfully whimsical, romantic, and just a little bit strange. Directed and choreographed by Lucia Lopez Sanchez, the film flows with a teasing charm, leading us through a story that hints of mystery, mischief, and fleeting joys without ever fully revealing its secrets. Every gesture and sequence is an unmissable balance of humor and drama. A cinematic delight, "Una Notte a Napoli" celebrates the joy, impermanence, and playful strangeness of everyday life.

programme.title: All's Well That Ends Well
programme.desc: Cold shoulder? There's a cure for that. When Helen (Jessica B. Hill) cures the King of France (Ben Carlson) of an ailment that has confounded every other doctor, he grants her lifetime wish: the marital hand of the aristocratic courtier Bertram (Jordin Hall). However, Bertram proves a reluctant husband and immediately heads off to war, leaving Helen with a seemingly impossible riddle to solve in order to seal their marriage.

programme.title: Carmen
programme.desc: "Carmen," directed by Andrew Margetson, captures the electric energy of flamenco on the backstreets of Sevilla with rising star Carmen Avilés. Shot on location in the streets of Sevilla and a local housing project, Avilés brings contemporary edge to a centuries-old art form. Dressed casually in a tracksuit, Carmen transforms ordinary spaces into stages, showing how tradition and modernity can collide in mesmerizing movement. "Carmen" is the latest in Margetson's acclaimed dance portrait series, following past SFDFF selections like "Isolation" and "Lil Buck with Icons of Modern Art.

programme.title: Don Giovanni Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart
programme.desc: Seducer, suborner, unscrupulous, savage, deaf to the lamentations of abandoned women, to the threats of their outraged fathers as to those of heaven, Don Juan the libertine listens only to his pleasures. But destiny is watching, and the vengeance of his victims awaits its time... What does the myth of Don Juan still have to say to us today? For Flemish director Guy Cassiers, the whirlwind of unrelenting love, the dizzying seductions, the swooning ingenues and the lively marivaudages are all fuelled by a hint of violence - physical, symbolic, political and social... But let the party begin! After brilliantly reviving Lully's Xerse and Purcell's Indian Queen in Lille, Guy Cassiers now turns his attention to the immortal seducer, tracking down the conflicts hidden behind his mask of sensual freedom. He has chosen to make her the face of a world in decline, halfway between the crudeness of a slaughterhouse and the splendour of a dazzling palace... Mirror contrasts, as Mozart and Da Ponte's masterpiece combines the most extreme feelings with the most graceful musical refinement... Already a partner of Guy Cassiers in 2015 and 2019, Emmanuelle Haïm returns here to a work in which her passion for Mozart and the singularity of the Concert d'Astrée's timbres work wonders. After the incandescent memories left in Lille by her Marriage of Figaro and a memorable Così fan tutte, here, for the centenary of the Opéra, is this summit of opera.

programme.title: Juditha Triumphans
programme.desc: Juditha triumphans is based on a Latin libretto by Iacopo Cassetti, itself inspired by the Old Testament Book of Judith. The Babylonian king Nebuchadnezzar sends his general Holofernes to conquer the city of Bethulia in Israel. To save her fellow Israelites, the courageous Juditha decides to seduce Holofernes. When he falls asleep, she cuts off his head. Juditha triumphans' is the only existing oratorio of the four Vivaldi composed. The intense atmosphere of war can be heard in the dramatic choral parts, and the faith and integrity of Juditha through the lyrical and tender writing.

programme.title: Fiction Friction
programme.desc: Fiction Friction, a title borrowed from the novelist and visual artist Édouard Levé, is an organic precipitate in which the singularities of the performers, their intimacies, their friendships, their differences, all tumble together. A melting pot of relationships created on the stage, from which emerge senses, friction, caresses and distances. Fiction Friction is a game, an orderly disorder, a theatrical travesty, a surge of vitality. These are all ingredients that Phia Ménard has turned into a collective dance experience. This young generation no longer wants to be divided or assigned. The show also reflects their freedom to think and to be.

programme.title: FEÛ - Fouad Boussouf
programme.desc: Fire and femininity collide in this electrifying performance by choreographer Fouad Boussouf, captured with rare intimacy by director Luc Riolon. Inspired by Boussouf's Moroccan roots and the elemental force of fire, nine female dancers unleash a genre-blending ritual of movement that is earthy, urgent, and unrelenting. Shot in a 360-degree space, the camera draws viewers into the circle as bodies ignite, collapse, and rise again in relentless motion. Each dancer channels fire's many forms: eruption, ember, and smoke, fusing hip-hop, contemporary, and North African styles into a hypnotic, communal trance. Driven by François Caffenne's pulsing score, this primal meditation on strength, memory, and transformation blazes with cyclical energy. What remains is not just a performance but a living force that is defiant and fiercely alive.

programme.title: Montreux Jazz Festival
programme.desc: From Compton to stardom, Kendrick Lamar's lyrical genius and fearless storytelling have made him a defining voice of modern hip-hop. In this episode of "Memory Lane," rapper Kendrick Lamar fills the stage of the 2013 Montreux Jazz Festival with raw energy and lyrical fire. Performing tracks from his breakthrough album "Good Kid, M.A.A.D City," backed by a live band, this is a performance you won't want to miss.

programme.title: Daniel Barenboim Crossing Borders: Music And Politics
programme.desc: Daniel Barenboim is constantly trying to find out what music can achieve and how it can inspire mankind. The first part of this documentary therefore focuses on the political impact of music and investigates whether it can be a means to overcome cultural differences. Thus it depicts UN Messenger of Peace Daniel Barenboim leading a spectacular concert in Gaza in May 2011, working with the West-Eastern-Divan Orchestra or travelling to Egypt and conducting for the first time ever the Cairo Symphony Orchestra. It features Barenboim discussing music and politics and other prominent figures of contemporary history such as Pierre Boulez, Joschka Fischer, Richard von Weizsäcker and others.

programme.title: Daniel Barenboim - Crossing Borders: Living with Music
programme.desc: In the second part, conductor and pianist Barenboim comes to the heart of music and investigates its phenomenology. He sketches how a score becomes music during rehearsals with the Staatskappelle Berlin, delineates the sublimity and richness of sound in a workshop about chamber music or demonstrates at the grand piano boundless ways of expression.

programme.title: Daniel Barenboim - Crossing Borders: Wagner - Music and Taboo
programme.desc: The third part focuses on Richard Wagner in reference to his taboo in Israel. Daniel Barenboim addresses the question whether music as an art form can be judged from a purely musical perspective or if it can't be separated from the views and beliefs of its creator.

programme.title: Move to Live with Akram Khan
programme.desc: Olivier Award-winning Actress and Director Kathryn Hunter is renowned for her work with physical theatre, notably with the pioneering theatre company Complicité, co-founded by her late husband Marcello Magni. She talks to Akram about her work with Marcello and how movement has always been a cornerstone of her approach to acting. Shakespeare has also been a cornerstone of Kathryn's career and she discusses her approach to playing the "Everest" of roles, King Lear, in two different productions spanning a 25-year timeframe. She also talks about how different stages make her move differently and recalls how screenwriter Joel Cohen wanted her to combine the physicality of a crow combined with a standing stone for his film The Tragedy of Macbeth. And Kathryn tells Akram how a serious accident left her with life-changing injuries but how this resulted in her thinking anew about how she could communicate physically.

programme.title: Antonio Pappano
programme.desc: Ignite your passion for music with conductor Sir Antonio Pappano. In this exclusive Marquee TV series, Pappano explores the history and artistry of three iconic symphonies, revealing the secrets that make them so extraordinary. In this episode, Pappano explores the life and work of Gustav Mahler taking a close look at his groundbreaking ''Symphony No.1.'' Stepping out into nature, where Mahler drew his inspiration, and back into the rehearsal room, Pappano unpacks the genius of Mahler's work. Learn how Mahler stretched the boundaries of the symphony, capturing the spirit of nature in his music, and how his First Symphony evolved from its disastrous premiere to one of Mahler's most beloved works. Along the way, musicians from The London Symphony Orchestra share their experiences and insights, offering a unique perspective on this heroic symphony.

programme.title: Juditha Triumphans
programme.desc: Juditha triumphans is based on a Latin libretto by Iacopo Cassetti, itself inspired by the Old Testament Book of Judith. The Babylonian king Nebuchadnezzar sends his general Holofernes to conquer the city of Bethulia in Israel. To save her fellow Israelites, the courageous Juditha decides to seduce Holofernes. When he falls asleep, she cuts off his head. Juditha triumphans' is the only existing oratorio of the four Vivaldi composed. The intense atmosphere of war can be heard in the dramatic choral parts, and the faith and integrity of Juditha through the lyrical and tender writing.

programme.title: Daniel Barenboim - Beethoven: Complete Piano Sonatas: No. 6, Op. 10.2
programme.desc: GRAMMY Award-winning pianist and conductor Daniel Barenboim tackles the so-called "New Testament" of music, Ludwig van Beethoven's thirty-two piano sonatas. Composed over twenty-five years and embodying the shift of musical taste from the Classic to the Romantic, their performance requires a musician of extraordinary versatility. Daniel Barenboim is one such pianist - his recordings run the gamut from Bach and Mozart to Bruckner and Bartók. In following in the footsteps of such masters as Artur Schnabel, Barenboim truly shows himself to be among the greatest living musicians.

programme.title: JA Robot Club
programme.desc: "JA Robot Club" is a playful, high-energy dance film where human movement meets mechanical precision. Created by the innovative JA Collective, this piece pairs six dancers with six small programmable robots, setting the stage for a bold experiment in timing, control, and mechanical and human connection. As the robots glide, spin, and pulse to their own mechanical rhythms, the dancers respond with sharp, responsive, and mesmerizing choreography. The robots don't just accompany the dancers, they lead, challenge, and occasionally surprise them. This is a joyful reminder that even in a tech-driven world, creativity still comes from how we move, adapt, and connect.

programme.title: Love's Labour's Lost
programme.desc: A king and three friends swear off women to devote themselves to their studies just as a princess and three ladies arrive on a diplomatic mission. Shakespeare delivers a touching and funny coming-of-age story with a twist ending, beautifully told in this "vibrant" and "sublime" Stratford Festival production.

programme.title: Shakespeare: The Tempest
programme.desc: In Shakespeare's great drama of loss and reconciliation, a long-deposed ruler uses magical arts to bring within her power the enemies who robbed her of her throne and marooned her on a remote island. But what revenge does she mean to take.

programme.title: Snow White: The Sacrifice
programme.desc: Laced with dread, this ruthless reimagining strips a fairy tale to its bones, exposing the raw terror of aging and vanishing self-worth. Liv Lorent's brutal staging, with text by Poet Laureate Carol Ann Duffy, resurrects the 1812 Grimm original, where Snow White's biological mother, not stepmother, orders her daughter's execution before descending into madness. Sarah Parish's narration cuts with icy precision while Aisha Naamani's silver-skinned Mirror haunts the stage, its reflections warped by Murray Gold's jagged score. Filmed by Ben Crompton (Game of Thrones), the production merges cinematic shadow with stagecraft as balletLORENT's dancers embody a living reflection of societal cruelty. When youth is currency and time is theft, what remains of a woman's value? This is no simple fairy tale, it's an unflinching autopsy of the beauty myth's casualties.

programme.title: Preljocaj in New York
programme.desc: Angelin Preljocaj was born into a family of Albanian immigrants in 1957 and received a solid training as a dancer in France before taking part in a course with Merce Cunningham in New York in 1980. His themes of love, war and labour are perennial human themes enriched by his carefully observed details from everyday life with a dance vocabulary strongly oriented towards physicality and sensuality. His own company, Ballet Preljocaj, resides at the Pavillon Noir in Aix-en-Provence, a building entirely dedicated to dance with Angelin Preljocaj its artistic director. His company is touring worldwide and gives about one hundred performances per year. His ballets SPECTRAL EVIDENCE and LA STRAVAGANZA were both conceived for the New York City Ballet. SPECTRAL EVIDENCE: From 2013 to music by John Cage is based on the Salem Witch Trials and a recording of vocal music by John Cage. It has four men in dark suits and clerical collars and four women in white dresses with different patches of red silicon. LA STRAVAGANZA: From 1997 to music by Vivaldi, Evelyn Ficarra, Serge Morand, Robert Marmandeau and Åke Parmerud deals with Contemporary Culture meeting 17th century society. Dancing to Vivaldi and electronic music we experience a merger of fantasy and reality, a dialogue of the past with the present, the old world with the new world.

programme.title: All's Well That Ends Well
programme.desc: Cold shoulder? There's a cure for that. When Helen (Jessica B. Hill) cures the King of France (Ben Carlson) of an ailment that has confounded every other doctor, he grants her lifetime wish: the marital hand of the aristocratic courtier Bertram (Jordin Hall). However, Bertram proves a reluctant husband and immediately heads off to war, leaving Helen with a seemingly impossible riddle to solve in order to seal their marriage.

programme.title: Montreux Jazz Festival
programme.desc: A jazz legend returns to the stage where he made history. George Benson's 2013 Montreux performance is a masterclass from a true musical giant. From child prodigy to global superstar, jazz fusion icon George Benson's career has been nothing short of extraordinary. Performing in clubs by age seven and releasing radio hits by eleven, "little Georgie Benson" grew into one of the most celebrated guitarists and vocalists in jazz history. With genre-defining albums like "Breezin'" and a career spanning over 80 years, Benson has earned 10 Grammy Awards across jazz, pop, and R&B. In this unforgettable 2013 Montreux set, his 16th appearance at the festival, Benson proves why he remains one of the greatest performers of our time. Set List: Big Parade No Gettin' Over You Swimming Pools (Drank) Give me The Night Turn Your Love Around Nothing's Gonna Change My Love For You Love Dance Unforgettable Route 66 Give me The Night Beyond the Sea ( La Mer) On Broadway.

programme.title: Tempest
programme.desc: "Tempest," starring Agnes Su of Stuttgart Ballet, is a mesmerizing dance film that captures the delicate tension between aspiration and self-acceptance. With stark simplicity and emotional honesty, Su's performance embodies the beauty and struggle of striving for perfection, revealing the quiet moments where vulnerability and grace meet. Elegant, intimate, and very moving, "Tempest" is a celebration of the artistry in imperfection and the courage it takes to dance on your own terms.

programme.title: Montreux Jazz Festival
programme.desc: Captured before the breakout success of his second album, British singer-songwriter Michael Kiwanuka delivers a soulful set at the 2014 Montreux festival. From the moment he arrived on the scene in 2011, Michael Kiwanuka stood out with his rich, velvety voice and timeless songwriting. This episode of "Memory Lane" takes a look back at the artist's early career, alongside footage from his 2014 Montreux Jazz Festival set. This Montreux performance captures a pivotal moment in Kiwanuka's career as he road-tests raw, unreleased songs while crafting what would become his breakthrough album "Love & Hate." This is a front-row seat to an artist on the brink of transformation. Set List: Barrowland Ballroom I like the Way This is Going Home Again The Cave Hard to See Tell me a Tale Always Waiting May This be Love (cover) I Felt the Rain Rest Home Again Everyday Place I Belong I'll Get Along.

programme.title: Una Notte a Napoli
programme.desc: Set to music by Pink Martini, "Una Notte a Napoli" ( A Night in Napoli) is a playful and cinematic dance film that is delightfully whimsical, romantic, and just a little bit strange. Directed and choreographed by Lucia Lopez Sanchez, the film flows with a teasing charm, leading us through a story that hints of mystery, mischief, and fleeting joys without ever fully revealing its secrets. Every gesture and sequence is an unmissable balance of humor and drama. A cinematic delight, "Una Notte a Napoli" celebrates the joy, impermanence, and playful strangeness of everyday life.

programme.title: Werther
programme.desc: Forbidden love, wrongdoings and anguish: the Opernhaus Zürich ventures into late 19th-century French romanticism with "Werther" by French composer Jules Massenet. A loose adaptation of Johann Wolfgang von Goethe's epistolary novel "The Sorrows of Young Werther", the opera is conducted by Germany's Cornelius Meister. It tells the story of the impossible union of poet Werther to Charlotte, a woman of duty already promised to a wealthy businessman.Goethe's drama is echoed in Massenet's score by emotionally wide-ranging vocal parts written on a grand scale.

programme.title: The Coronation of King George II
programme.desc: The King's Consort is one of the world's leading period instrument choirs and orchestras. Founded in 1980 by Robert King, they have toured all five continents and have appeared in almost every European country, as well as Japan, Hong Kong and the Far East. For more than three decades, The King's Consort, under the artistic direction of Robert King, has performed a wide variety of repertoire from 1550 to the present day. Historical reconstruction of a major event, this concert benefits from the exceptional setting of the Royal Chapel of Versailles which, having never known the coronation of a king of France, will know during this exceptional evening its first coronation, English moreover.

programme.title: Daniel Barenboim - Beethoven: Complete Piano Sonatas: No. 16, Op. 31.1
programme.desc: GRAMMY Award-winning pianist and conductor Daniel Barenboim tackles the so-called "New Testament" of music, Ludwig van Beethoven's thirty-two piano sonatas. Composed over twenty-five years and embodying the shift of musical taste from the Classic to the Romantic, their performance requires a musician of extraordinary versatility. programme.title: Matthew Bourne's The Red Shoes
programme.desc: Filmed at Sadler's Wells in 2019, Matthew Bourne's The Red Shoes is a triumphant adaptation of the legendary 1948 feature film by Micheal Powell and Emeric Pressburger. The double Olivier Award-winning show is Hans Christian Andersen's tale of obsession, possession, and one girl's dream to be the greatest dancer in the world. Victoria Page, played by Ashley Shaw - winner of a National Dance Award for her performance - lives to dance, but her ambitions become a battleground between the two men who inspire her passion: composer Julian Craster played by original cast member Dominic North, and legendary impresario Boris Lermontov, performed by the great Adam Cooper. Set to the achingly romantic music of golden-age Hollywood composer Bernard Herrmann, The Red Shoes is orchestrated by Terry Davies and performed live by the New Adventures Orchestra, with cinematic designs by Lez Brotherston, lighting by Paule Constable, sound by Paul Groothuis, and projection by Duncan McLean. The Red Shoes will dazzle your senses and break your heart.

programme.title: Instinct
programme.desc: Three fighters, one vital resource, no room for compromise. "Instinct" is a tense, physically charged short dance film built around a single life-or-death struggle. As the dancers clash over water, their movement becomes a test of endurance, urgency, and survival. Their movements are sharp, stripped-back, and unflinching. Bodies strain, collide, and resist, mirroring the brutal realities of scarcity and entitlement. Every action carries consequences, and every choice exposes what desperation can bring in each of us. With a stark visual language and urgent momentum, this is a gripping meditation on survival, power, and the cost of getting what we need.

programme.title: Daniel Barenboim Crossing Borders: Music And Politics
programme.desc: Daniel Barenboim is constantly trying to find out what music can achieve and how it can inspire mankind. The first part of this documentary therefore focuses on the political impact of music and investigates whether it can be a means to overcome cultural differences. Thus it depicts UN Messenger of Peace Daniel Barenboim leading a spectacular concert in Gaza in May 2011, working with the West-Eastern-Divan Orchestra or travelling to Egypt and conducting for the first time ever the Cairo Symphony Orchestra. It features Barenboim discussing music and politics and other prominent figures of contemporary history such as Pierre Boulez, Joschka Fischer, Richard von Weizsäcker and others.

programme.title: Sir Simon Rattle - Berliner Philharmoniker - Anderson / Dvořák / Brahms
programme.desc: Even if the music world is often dominated by rivalry, examples of genuine friendships can certainly be found. Take Johannes Brahms and Antonín Dvořák: a pair whose friendship was free of self-interest. "That fellow has more ideas than all the rest of us. Even what he tosses into the trash could serve as a main theme for anyone else," Brahms once remarked about his Czech colleague, 8 years his junior - and he didn't just stop at nice compliments. In 1877 Brahms recommended his publisher Fritz Simrock to take on Dvořák, at the time a completely unknown composer from Prague. And sure enough, his first publication, the spirited Slavonic Dances, enjoyed a sensational success. The Berlin Philharmonic paid homage to this musical friendship by pairing Dvořák's bravura score with the "summerly" Second Symphony of Brahms, also composed in 1877. And as an "appetizer" Sir Simon Rattle has commissioned a new work from his compatriot Julian Anderson, which provided a brief but substantial entrée into what followed.

programme.title: Jacob Collier - Jazzopen Stuttgart
programme.desc: Jacob Collier (vocals, instruments) Alita Moses (Vocals and Percussion), Ben Jones (Guitar), Christian Euman (Drums), Erin Bentlage (Keyboards and Vocals), Lindsey Lomis (Guitar and Vocals), Robin Mullarkey (Bass) Jazzopen Stuttgart, 7 July 2025.

programme.title: Mark Guiliana Jazz Quartet
programme.desc: Mark Guiliana is one of the most active drummers of his generation. He appears on all musical fronts, from the most experimental to the most challenging. Spotted in Avishai Cohen's band with whom he has recorded six albums, he has also played with Meshell Ndegeocello, Dhafer Youssef, Matisyahu, and Gretchen Parlato. His duo with Brad Mehldau, the inspiring Mehliana, is a reference in electronic music. The Jazz Quartet is a "classic" formula in which he has enlisted the services of old friends, notably that of pianist and arranger Jason Lindner.

programme.title: Don Giovanni Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart
programme.desc: Seducer, suborner, unscrupulous, savage, deaf to the lamentations of abandoned women, to the threats of their outraged fathers as to those of heaven, Don Juan the libertine listens only to his pleasures. But destiny is watching, and the vengeance of his victims awaits its time... What does the myth of Don Juan still have to say to us today? For Flemish director Guy Cassiers, the whirlwind of unrelenting love, the dizzying seductions, the swooning ingenues and the lively marivaudages are all fuelled by a hint of violence - physical, symbolic, political and social... But let the party begin! After brilliantly reviving Lully's Xerse and Purcell's Indian Queen in Lille, Guy Cassiers now turns his attention to the immortal seducer, tracking down the conflicts hidden behind his mask of sensual freedom. He has chosen to make her the face of a world in decline, halfway between the crudeness of a slaughterhouse and the splendour of a dazzling palace... Mirror contrasts, as Mozart and Da Ponte's masterpiece combines the most extreme feelings with the most graceful musical refinement... Already a partner of Guy Cassiers in 2015 and 2019, Emmanuelle Haïm returns here to a work in which her passion for Mozart and the singularity of the Concert d'Astrée's timbres work wonders. After the incandescent memories left in Lille by her Marriage of Figaro and a memorable Così fan tutte, here, for the centenary of the Opéra, is this summit of opera.

programme.title: Antonio Pappano
programme.desc: Ignite your passion for music with conductor Sir Antonio Pappano. In this exclusive Marquee TV series, Pappano explores the history and artistry of three iconic symphonies, revealing the secrets that make them so extraordinary. In this episode, Pappano explores the life and work of Ludwig van Beethoven, taking a closer look at his brilliant Symphony No.7. Like the man himself, Beethoven's 7th Symphony is a piece of extraordinary expressiveness and emotional extremes. Sitting in the rehearsal room with the London Symphony Orchestra, Pappano explores the the inner workings of this iconic symphony and the history surrounding the composition, pointing out Beethoven's inspirations from familiar folk dances to Napoleon's military campaigns, and the sublime beauty of nature. Along the way hear from members of the orchestra about what it's like to play such a magnificent, and sometimes tiring piece. This is a wholistic look at one of Beethoven's most recognizable symphonies guaranteed to give you a newfound appreciation for his sublime melodies, iron-clad rhythms, and heartbreaking slow movements.

programme.title: Madama Butterfly
programme.desc: The much sought-after stage director and performer Olivier Py, who has put on more than forty works of opera around the world, will be tackling Madama Butterfly for the first time, placing the orchestra up on stage inside the Odeon of Herodes Atticus, and filling the Roman outdoor venue with the aesthetics and colours of Japan, as filtered through his own signature directorial style. Working with him to create the sets and costumes is his long-time collaborator Pierre-André Weitz. Giacomo Puccini's "Japanese tragedy", first presented at La Scala in Milan in 1904, tells the story of the star-crossed love harboured by the fifteen-year-old geisha Cio-Cio-San for Benjamin Franklin Pinkerton, a lieutenant in the United States Navy. An American officer acquired the services of the young geisha Miss Butterfly at an expense of 39 dollars per month. Four dollars of this bought the license that entitled her to be his mistress, and to a daily bath in the public bathhouse. He paid her 25 dollars a month and hired a room and a servant for her, which cost another ten dollars. For this sum, he enjoyed all the comforts of a married man for a set time, and she had a roof over her head and a servant at her command. On leaving for America, he promised he would return to her when the robins nest again but in fact deserted her, leaving her desperately poor, with babe in arms. The author John Luther Long was inspired by this account of a real-life young geisha called Cio-Cio-San -recounted to him by his sister, who had lived in Nagasaki- to start writing his own short story of the tale, which formed the basis for a theatre play and, subsequently, Puccini's opera.

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Vendi je izabrana za ""tinejdžerku nedelje"" za jedan vebzin. Izveštač i fotograf će je pratiti čitav dan. To je ostvarenje sna za Vendi koja želi da bude zvezda na internetu! Ali moraće da naće način da spreči Marinu da se meša i sve pokvari.

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Vendi saznaje da stari milioner traži svoju lutku iz detinjstva i spreman je da plati čitavo bogatstvo da bi se dokopao Marininog plišanog zeca Luleta. Ali postoji caka: Marina nikad ne bi prodala svoju omiljenu igračku.

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Škola priređuje nagradnu igru, a glavna nagrada je ajped. Marina mora da ga osvoji! Vendi vidi priliku da prestane da deli svoj ajped sa sestrom i odlučuje da joj pomogne da kupi što više lozova. Ali za to bi morale da zarade nešto novca... Šta ako prirede dvorišnu rasprodaju na kojoj će prodavati stvari iz kuće.

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Roditelji su izašli, pa Vendi mora da čuva Marinu... Ali Vendi i Maksans slave svoju hiljaditu poruku i nema šanse da im mala napast uništi ovaj poseban dan! Vendi moli Maksansovu rođaku Mel da čuva Marinu... ali uskoro shvata da su Mel i Marina postale vrlo bliske... Čak izgleda kao da je Marina našla sjajnu novu sestru..

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Sestrama je dosta domaćeg, raspremanja soba i postavljanja stola! Dosta poslova! Marina i Vendi bi volele da budu kao njihovi roditelji, koji ne rade ništa i samo komanduju deci. Tata ih izaziva da zamene uloge.

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Marina saznaje da Vendi odlazi u letnji kamp na planini sa svojom drugaricom Sami. Ploviće kajakom, plivaće, voziće se... I Marina žarko želi da ide sa njima! Uz to, roditelji se slažu: mogu samo da zamisle mir i tišinu bez sestara u kući! Ali Vendi se ta zamisao uopšte ne dopada: kampovanje sa štetočinom? Ozbiljno.

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Vendi je dozlogrdilo da joj Marina krade dnevnik. Maksans joj daje sjajnu ideju: šta kad bi mala napast imala sopstveni dnevnik? Vendi daje Marini njen prvi dnevnik... Mala napast je oduševljena, ali ubrzo se zapita šta bi mogla da napiše u njega... Tajne o svojoj starijoj sestri, naravno.

programme.title: Džeronimo Stilton
programme.desc: Džeronimo je gospodin miš koji, pored toga što voli svoj posao i svoju porodicu, obožava da skuplja korice starog sira iz osamnaestog veka. Mrzi da putuje jer mu svako putovanje, bilo brodom, kolima ili avionom, izaziva mučninu... Ali ga, bez obzira na to, porodica uvlači u najneverovatnije pustolovine svuda po svetu.

Tako se rađa najpoznatiji maskirani heroj. Zoro jednostavno ismeva svoje protivnike učeći ih lekciji i potpisuje svoja dela zaštitnim znakom "Z".

programme.title: Ulica zagonetki
programme.desc: U parku Leksington kruže priče o tome da postoji skriveno mesto iza mosta gde, bez ikakvih tragova ili objašnjenja, nestaju psi. Kada pas čoveka detektiva iz Skotland Jarda nestane, Mekfler traži od Klever da mu pomogne da razjasni ovu gotovo nemoguću pojavu.

programme.title: Ulica zagonetki
programme.desc: Detektiv Mekfler i njegova ekipa tolerišu poznatog odmetnika "Robina Huda," zagonetnog psa koji krade neprodatu hranu za ljude da bi je delio lutalicama iz balona. Sve dok im jednog dana ne pošalje poruku u kojoj preti kraljici.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! i veverice
programme.desc: Alvin moli Dejva da provedu vikend samo njih dvojica. Dejv pristane i biva uvučen u niz Alvinovih divljih avantura.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! i veverice
programme.desc: Alvin moli Dejva da provedu vikend samo njih dvojica. Dejv pristane i biva uvučen u niz Alvinovih divljih avantura.

programme.title: Pets klub
programme.desc: U Pets klubu je opšta pometnja jer školske novine traže novog saradnika. Tim i Oskar se takmiče, jer će samo onaj koji donese najbolju vest postati novinar. Tim beleži svedočenja o prisustvu čudovišta u školi, a na kraju se ispostavlja da je to bezazleni ali brzi primat lori. Kako je ova retka i egzotična životinja dospela ovamo? Lorija zbog infekcije odvode kod Žilua, koji prepoznaje da je on žrtva krijumčarenja. Da bi našli krijumčara i spasili ugrožene životinje, članovi Pets kluba moraju da pokažu hrabrost.

programme.title: Pets klub
programme.desc: Mengov papagaj Alfi obično je vrlo pričljiv... Ali jednog jutra odjednom više ne govori! Zašto? To je zagonetka koju Pets klub mora da reši. Mengova starija sestra je najozbiljniji osumnjičeni. Da li je papagaj Alfi video nešto i hteo to da ponovi.

programme.title: Mali Šef: Nazad u kolevku
programme.desc: Nagon događaja u filmu Mali Šef 2, odraslom poslovnom čoveku Teodoru Templtonu smeštena je pronevera u kompaniji i primoran je da se vrati svom starom ja, Malom Šefu, i živi sa svojim bratom Timom. Ali da bi to izveo, mora da navede Timovu porodicu da mu dopusti da ostane, i ubedi Bebiko da mu vrati njegov stari posao... Koji trenutno obavlja njegova nećaka, beba Tina.

programme.title: Mali Šef: Nazad u kolevku
programme.desc: Nagon događaja u filmu Mali Šef 2, odraslom poslovnom čoveku Teodoru Templtonu smeštena je pronevera u kompaniji i primoran je da se vrati svom starom ja, Malom Šefu, i živi sa svojim bratom Timom. programme.title: Ulica zagonetki
programme.desc: Atina poziva Klever i Broa pošto je njenog vlasnika naučnika i nju napao duh partnera njenog vlasnika, koji je poginuo u nesreći pre 20 godina, a sada preti da se osveti.

programme.title: Anderdog - Kuconja
programme.desc: Kuconja i Av-Av moraju da nauče da razmisle pre nego što nešto urade, jer menjaju sve policajce koji su na konvenciji. Mačkoslav planira najveću pljačku u istoriji grada, uz pomoć svog mlađeg brata. Nažalost, on ima drugačije planove za taj dan.

programme.title: Anderdog - Kuconja
programme.desc: Kada Lošika na prevaru navede Velikog Psa da oslobodi i preuzme duh veštice Ljutke koja izaziva svađe, nastaje džumbus jer Veliki Pas/Ljutka izaziva svađe ne samo među građanima, već i među braniocima! Uspeh branilaca u spasavanju grada zavisi od toga mogu li da zanemare svoje razlike i sarađuju... Ali to će biti teško, jer je najgora svađa u ekipi ona između... Av-Ava i Kuconje.

programme.title: Nekada Davno - Predmeti
programme.desc: Na putu do bazena, Maestro se gubi u 17. veku i saznaje da su se svi kupali nagi, niko se nije stideo! Nekoliko godina kasnije, stvari su obrnute: ako hoćeš da plivaš, moraš da budeš obučen od glave do pete.

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Vendi se nada da će moći da provede mirno veče kod kuće sa Maksansom dok njeni roditelji nisu tu, ali Marina je pozvala svoje drugarice Natu i Lulu. Da bi ih se rešila, Vendi izmišlja strašnu priču i ubeđuje devojčice da je komšijski baštenski patuljak u stvari pakleno stvorenje patuljak Flop.

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Sve Vendine drugarice su uverene da Marinina omiljena igračka donosi sreću. Samo Vendi smatra da to nije istina, ali ono što se događa ne ide u prilog njenom mišljenju! I to toliko da sada svi žele da se dokopaju igračke koja donosi sreću..

programme.title: Barbi i čarolija duge
programme.desc: Kada i drugi put spasi Feritopiju, Elini malo udara uspeh u glavu. Azura je poseti na Čarobnoj livadi, i pozove nju u kristalnu palatu da bi je usposobila za pomoćnu vilu, i da može učestvovati u proletnom letu, na ritualu koji oživljuje prvu proletnu dugu. U kristalnoj palati Elina susreće ostale pomoćne vile koje - slično njoj - pripremaju se na proletni let. Samo se stvari ne odvijaju kako se Elina nadala, slučajno pada u klopku kada svoju čaroliju baci na krastavu žabu koja se čini nevinom. Krastava žaba nije ništa drugo nego Laverna koga čarolija vrati u prvotni oblik poništavajući zlu čaroliju, puštajući da Feritopiji čini neugodnosti. Posle toga Laverna pusti duboki san na stražarske vile i pokuša izvesti svoju zlu nameru. Pomoćne vile moraju ujediniti svu svoju snagu da spreče Lavernu da Feritopiju pokrije sa zimom na 10 godina. Da li je snaga ujedinjenja dovoljna da nadvladaju Lavernu i da ožive prvu dugu.

programme.title: Barbi: Avanture u kući iz snova
programme.desc: Stejsi i Skiper se svađaju, pa im Barbi nudi da zameni sobu sa njima. Na kraju sve sestre Roberts otkrivaju da nema savršene cimerke.

programme.title: LEGO Friends: Novo poglavlje
programme.desc: Vreme je da se sve ideje za Društveni centar pretvore u stvarnost. Deca donose svu potrebnu opremu i odlaze u Društveni centar da spakuju stare stvari, podignu pozornicu i ukrase prostor, ali tamo će ih čekati neprijatno iznenađenje. Pejzli je pomerila sve njihove stvari kako bi društvo penzionera uživalo u boćanju.

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Dve sestre. Dve eksplozivne ličnosti. Pod jednim krovom. Sestre je komedija o svakodnevnom životu dve sestre, od kojih jedna ima 7, a druga 13 godina. Marin je i dalje dete, dok njena starija sestra Vendi ulazi u tinejdžerske godine. Obe su temperamentne, veoma različite ličnosti i obožavaju se! Marin je naivna, simpatična, veoma hiperaktivna i veoma napadna. Ona uvek smišlja lude ideje da bi privukla pažnju svoje sestre, dok Vendi više teži životu odrasle osobe. Ova komedija karaktera govori o bratstvu/sestrinstvu.

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Dve sestre. Dve eksplozivne ličnosti. Pod jednim krovom. Sestre je komedija o svakodnevnom životu dve sestre, od kojih jedna ima 7, a druga 13 godina. Marin je i dalje dete, dok njena starija sestra Vendi ulazi u tinejdžerske godine. Obe su temperamentne, veoma različite ličnosti i obožavaju se! Ova komedija karaktera govori o bratstvu/sestrinstvu.

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Vendi je otišla u tinejdžerski kamp na dve nedelje... Za Marinu, to je prava večnost! Kad se njena starija sestra vrati kući, Marina je presrećna i odmah se lepi za nju! Ali Vendi jedva čeka da vidi Maksansa, koji je isplanirao romantično veče sa svojom devojkom..

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! i veverice
programme.desc: Britanin san da postane modna kreatorka pretvori se u noćnu moru kad joj na poslu ukradu ideje.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! i veverice
programme.desc: Alvin nasluti da je Dejv lokalni pljačkaš banaka kad Dejv počne da se ponaša sumnjivo i poklanja stvari dečacima.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! i veverice
programme.desc: Teodor mora da dokaže da je dorastao zadatku kad veverice odu u svemirski kamp.

programme.title: Pustolovine sa Braćom Kret
programme.desc: Martin i Kris učestvuju u urnebesnom takmičenju da bi otkrili ko bolje sadi žirove, šojke ili veverice. Čudan kvar moćnih odela pretvara Martina u žir, koji će zatim izrasti u hrast! Kris aktivira odelo sa moćima veverice, ali upada u kandže risa i jastreba kokošara. Aviva, Koki i Džimi ne mogu da ih nađu. Ekipa Kret i njihova ljubav prema životinjama moraće da ih izvuku iz ovog nereda.

programme.title: Pustolovine sa Braćom Kret
programme.desc: Braća Kret žele da prelete svet sa najbržom životinjom na svetu, sivim sokolom, koji može da leti brzinom do 380 k/h. Ali njihov plan završava u zapećku kada ih ostatak ekipe Kret izaziva da nađu sokola u gradu umesto u divljini, a Krisovo moćno odelo odjednom aktiviraju moći goluba! Otkrivaju da Zak šalje svoje Zakobote da očiste zgradu u kojoj su gnezda sivog sokola sa ptićima! Martin i Kris moraju da aktiviraju moći sivog sokola i iskoriste silu gravitacije da bi izveli spasavanje životinja u letu.

programme.title: Nekada Davno - Predmeti
programme.desc: Baterija Maestrovog telefona je prazna! Bez načina da javi Psi da će zakasniti, Maestro juri na mesto sastanka i usput nam pokazuje preteču modernog telefona: dečju igru sa dve čaše povezane kanapom.

programme.title: Nekada Davno - Predmeti
programme.desc: Dok traži nedostajući deo slagalice, Maestro se gubi u drevnim vremenima, gde je njegov prijatelj Arhimed upravo izmislio Lokulus, prvu poznatu slagalicu. Nakon svraćanja u Kinu, gde otkriva Tangram, Maestro se vraća u Nemačku sedamnaestog veka.

programme.title: Radoznali Džordž
programme.desc: Kanapi, korpa i mnogo vrućeg vazduha: Džordž otkriva da su sve tri stvari potrebne kako bi balon uspešno poleteo. A gospođa Renkins pokazuje kako balon leti pomoću vrućeg vazduha. / Neka mačka čudnog izgleda jede Džordžov sendvič sa kikiriki puterom i džemom. Ali čekaj, to nije mačka, to je tvor! A Džordž je zadivljen.

programme.title: Radoznali Džordž
programme.desc: Kada Džordž nabasa na rupu koju je napravio glodar u polju blizu seoske kuće, odjednom će se naći u tajnom svetu podzemnih tunela. / Profesorka Mudrić poverava Džordžu brigu o Lakiju, mačetu koje je premlado da bi brinulo o sebi. Laki se zaljubljuje na prvi pogled kada upozna svog prvog psa, Handlija.

programme.title: Pets klub
programme.desc: Ludovi mama i tata dele starateljstvo nad njim, što znači da je on jedne nedelje kod svog tate, a druge kod svoje mame. Da bi izbegli sukobe, roditelji su mu kupili sve dvostruko: stvari za školu, računare i konzole za igru, pa čak i dva pacova. A kad jedan od njih nestane, Pets klub hitno stupa na scenu! Ubrzo otkrivaju da su pacovi bili par i da ih je Ludov otac razdvojio. Pa ako je jedan pacov nestao, to je zato što želi da nađe svog partnera (neke vrste pacova su veoma vezane za svog partnera).

programme.title: Pets klub
programme.desc: Mužjak domaće korejske veverice Noazet pobegao je od svojih vlasnika, Solen i Žeremija, mada izgleda da se vrlo dobro odnose prema njemu.. Kuda je otišao? I, što je još važnije, kako da ga nađu?! Osetljiv zadatak za Pets klub, naročito pošto Nina i Oskar ne mogu da računaju na Tima, koji je kažnjen. Glavni osumnjičeni naših detektiva su sestra i brat, Solen i Žeremi, koji ne prestaju da optužuju jedno drugo.

programme.title: Pets klub
programme.desc: Pets klub dobija poziv nakon nestanka šteneta džek rasela tokom rođendanske zabave njegovog vlasnika Žordana, veoma neprijatnog i razmaženog dečaka. Klub počinje proučavanjem video-snimka sa zabave i sumnja da je jedan od tri Žordanova najbolja druga ukrao štene. Problem je u tome što svako od njih ima čvrst alibi! Ali mali detalji ih ubrzo razotkrivaju i naši istraživači shvataju da štene nije ukrao jedan lopov, već trojica, da bi očitali lekciju Žordanu koji je postao nepodnošljiv.

programme.title: Pets klub
programme.desc: Kako je Julijin sjajni papagaj Mocart mogao da izađe iz svog kaveza? Naši drugari iz Pets kluba najpre sumnjaju na kradljivca egozičnih životinja, ali onda otkrivaju da su makao papagaji veoma spretni sa kandžama i sposobni da sami otvore svoje kaveze. Dakle, Mocart je pobegao sam, iz nepoznatog razloga. Oni prate trag trake malih Indijanaca, na kojoj je perje koje bi moglo da bude Mocartovo.

programme.title: Garfild
programme.desc: Al je beznadežan kao šinter i njegov šef gospodin Štenara možda mu neće dati 97. drugu priliku da stvarno uhvati psa. Ali izglasan je novi zakon: psi bez povoca završiće u štenari! Kada Al ugleda Odija bez povoca u parku, pomisli da će uspeti, ali dok mu on čita njegova prava, psić beži. U potrazi za Odijem, zabrinuti Džon nailazi na gospodina Štenaru, koji mu nudi Alov posao. Na veliko iznenađenje svojih ljubimaca, Džon prihvata ponudu i postaje prilično uspešan šinter koristeći hranu iz frižidera kao mamac. Ali prazan frižider je prosto previše za Garfilda i Odija. Oni odlučuju da pomognu neutešnom Alu da vrati svoj posao.

programme.title: Garfild
programme.desc: Izbor za potpuno savršenu macu! A prva nagrada u toj emisiji je 10 tona novca, što znači... Garfild misli... Pa 20 tona rebaraca! Garfild bi voleo da pobedi i Džon je poslao njegovu veoma lepu sliku, ali zar Nermal nema bolje šanse? Brendon Tračara objavljuje ime pobednika: to je Garfild! Kad čuje da je pobedio, Garfild je doslovno paralisan od šoka. Ali čekaj! Meri Margaret Frin, sudija u emisiji, kaže da je došlo do greške: pravi pobednik je Nermal. Garfild je prva pratilja. Da li to znači da će, ako Nermal izgubi prvo mesto, on dobiti nagradu? Ali šta je tačno potrebno za oduzimanje nagrade? Paparaci fotografije? Garfild i Odi imaju foto-aparat.

programme.title: Pustolovine sa Braćom Kret
programme.desc: Aviva želi da napravi mrežu ishrane u afričkoj savani, pa osmišljava igru, a Martin i Kris prihvataju izazov! Svako od njih počeće kao vlat trave i popeti se do vrha lanca ishrane u igri pod imenom ""Označavanje moćnih odela"". Tokom igre, braća proširuju svoje znanje o složenim odnosima između grabljivaca i plena, i o razlikama između mesojeda i biljojeda.

programme.title: Pustolovine sa Braćom Kret
programme.desc: Dok se priprema za životinjski maskenbal, ekipa Kret počinje da primećuje da se u Tortugi dešavaju razne čudne stvari. Džimi je siguran da sa njima živi duh ili čudovište, ali braća Kret su ubeđena da je to neko stvorenje. Kada ekipa reši da otkrije ko to pravi nevolje, otkriće da neke životinje privlače ljudska staništa jer im obezbeđuju hranu i zaštitu od grabljivaca.

programme.title: Pustolovine sa Braćom Kret
programme.desc: Kad smanjeni Kris završi prekriven polenom, zalepljen za pčelu, zaputiće se u neverovatan svet oprašivača. Martin, Aviva i ostatak istraživača životinja moraju da nađu Krisa u avanturi koja otkriva zadivljujući odnos biljaka i njihovih životinjskih partnera. Otkrivaju da biljke koriste životinje da im pomognu da prenesu semenje procesom koji se zove oprašivanje.

programme.title: Mali Šef: Nazad na posao
programme.desc: Uz pomoć svog starijeg brata i partnera, Tima, Mali šef nastavlja da se bori u surovom korporativnom svetu firme Baby Corps, dok se svim silama trudi da postigne skoro neverovatnu stvar: balans između poslovnog i privatnog života.

programme.title: Mali Šef: Nazad na posao
programme.desc: Uz pomoć svog starijeg brata i partnera, Tima, Mali šef nastavlja da se bori u surovom korporativnom svetu firme Bebeći Odred, dok se svim silama trudi da postigne skoro neverovatnu stvar: balans između poslovnog i privatnog života.

programme.title: Garfild
programme.desc: Abu Dabi nije dovoljno daleko! Garfild prosto mora da pošalje Nermala u... Kinu, ili će to nežno i neizbežno mače provesti čitavo leto sa njim! Ali kada Garfild shvati da je i Odi upao u kutiju sa Nermalom, juriće kombi poštara Hermana sve do aerodroma. Fju! Stiže do vrata za prtljag, ali tada otkriva da su sve kutije potpuno iste, i dok pronađe njihov paket, avion već sleće u Šangaj! Kada dospeju na pokretnu traku, mogu da čuju da čuvar viče da su odvezani ljubimci zabranjeni na aerodromu. Brzo! Garfild uzima kutiju u kojoj misli da je Nermal, i beži odatle. Ali ko je taj Voldo, čudni tip u mantilu, koji drži veoma sličnu kutiju? Kada Garfild otvori kutiju da oslobodi Nermala, umesto njega će ugledati zlatnu statuetu mačke. Pa šta je tu je! A mogao bi i da zameni statuetu za lazanje... Zahvaljujući tački sa tužnim očima broj 1685, Garfild i Odi uspevaju da navedu Dingbenga, nećaka vlasnika radnje sa rezancima, da ih nahrani. Za to vreme, Voldo dostavlja paket Beli Belisimi, operskoj divi, koja ispušta najužasnije visoke tonove kada u kutiji otkrije Nermala.

programme.title: Garfild
programme.desc: Uz pomoć Belinih užasnih sijamskih mačaka, Voldo je oteo Garfilda, Odija i Dinbenga. Bela se raduje što je dobila zlatnu mačku, jer je ona ključna za blago Fukanglonga, čuvara najvrednijeg dijamanta, koji bi omogućio Beli Belisimi da sagradi svoju koncertnu halu. Ali kada Voldo skenira statuu, ne uspeva da u njoj nađe mapu i... Dingbeng, Garfild, Odi i Nermal uspevaju da pobegnu sa statuom, izlazeći kroz prozor i završavajući na platformi za čišćenje prozora. Bela i njena ekipa jure za njima. Ovo je početak napete vožnje tricikla po krcatim ulicama Šangaja. Srećom, Garfild nalazi smrdljivo voće durijan, koje baca Beli u lice. Njihovi neprijatelji završavaju u kontejneru! Na kraju, nazad u restoranu, mesečina odjednom osvetljava statuine oči-dragulje, projektujući dvodimenzionalnu sliku tigrove glave, čija zagonetka ih šalje u drevni vrt u kom će naći polovinu medaljona. Ali drugu polovinu čuva stari gospodar hrama na planini Čingšan, a sijamske mačke su pratile naše drugare.

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Mama odlučuje da opere sve u kući što ne miriše baš prijatno. Marininu igračku Luleta, Vendinu majicu sa autogramom rokera, čak i tatinu omiljenu majicu. Ali pranje može da upropasti njihove voljene stvari, pa sestre i otac pokušavaju baš sve da bi spasili svoja mala blaga.

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Mama je osvojila odmaranje u spa centru za vikend, ali tata ima posla i ne može da pođe sa njom. Koga će povesti sa sobom? Marinu ili Vendi? Na mamino zaprepašćenje, devojke daju sve od sebe da joj pokažu koja od njih je slađa.

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Roditeljima su dozlogrdile svađe sestara i odlučuju da ih razdvoje tokom pet nedelja letnjeg raspusta tako što će poslati Vendi u jezički kamp u drugoj državi. Marina i Vendi su najpre oduševljene! Ali baš pre nego što Vendi ode, sestre shvataju da je pet nedelja razdvojenosti veoma dugo. Predugo... Trudeći se da ne priznaju to jedna drugoj, obe će dati sve od sebe da ostanu zajedno.

programme.title: Hotel za ljubimce
programme.desc: NeiNei, Bubu, Viki i Lili pričaju o tome ko je najvažnija životinja u hotelu za ljubimce, kada u hotel stiže patak. Patak se hvali svojim iskustvima: živeo je u Londonu, bio je na odmoru na Havajima, dvaput je pio popodnevni čaj sa engleskom kraljicom, dvaput je nastupao u Operi Metropoliten... NeiNei je iznerviran i poziva patka na takmičenje u hvalisanju. Da bi dokazao da je i on već bio na najvišoj planini na svetu, NeiNei mora da hoda po konopcu između dve zgrade.

programme.title: Hotel za ljubimce
programme.desc: Divno je jutro. Robin ustaje rano da očisti hotel za ljubimce. Tajanstvena mačka ga posmatra kroz prozor. NeiNei uzima piletinu i povrće iz automata kada začuje buku napolju. Otvara vrata i ne vidi nikoga. Vraća se do automata, ali on je odjednom izgubio kontrolu. Viki misli da je NeiNei promenio podešavanja na automatu. NeiNei poriče. Kasnije, u hotelu za ljubimce se dešavaju čudne stvari: Lilijeva kost je nestala, Vikin kolač se pomera i priča, a Bubu misli da je kuća ukleta.

programme.title: Pets klub
programme.desc: Elizinog psa Šušua udario je auto. Ta nesreća ostavila mu je toliku traumu da se sada plaši i najtišeg zvuka motora. Zahvaljujući velikoj solidarnosti članova Pets kluba, oni pokušavaju da obuče Šušua, povrate mu samopouzdanje i ponovo ga naviknu na zvuke automobila. Vode ga na raskrsnicu na kojoj je doživeo nesreću. Ali da li će Šušu prevazići svoju traumu.

programme.title: Pets klub
programme.desc: Žan-Ed je izgubio psa svoje majke i mora da ga vrati do popodneva, inače će ga poslati u internat. To izgleda kao lak zadatak za Pets klub: stari pas, obezbeđena vila i sumnjivi batler... Međutim, njihov prvi trag je pogrešan. Zlonamerna osoba odlučuje da to snimi i postavi snimak na internet. Oni su poniženi. I još gore, suparnički klub S.O.S. životinje odlučuje da završi istragu njima iza leđa.

programme.title: Anderdog - Kuconja
programme.desc: Zahvaljujući montaži snimka, Lošika pokazuje ljudima Kapitol Sitija da ih branioci dovode u opasnost. Gradonačelnica je besna i otpušta ih. Lošika je sad glavna u štabu i zarobljava Poli. Kuconja i branioci će krišom morati da dokažu svoju nevinost.

programme.title: Anderdog - Kuconja
programme.desc: Da bi osvojio nagradu za najboljeg pronalazača u gradu, Simke šalje hipnotišuće dronove da navedu ljude da se dive njemu, a ne Poli, njegovoj bivšoj pomoćnici. Hipnotisana Poli sada radi za Simketa.

programme.title: Ulica zagonetki
programme.desc: Prestižni dijamant izložen u Britanskom muzeju upravo je ukraden i krađa nosi potpis Vorogula, ozloglašenog patuljka kradljivca dijamanata. Problem je u tome što je pomenuti kradljivac još uvek zatvoren u veoma dobro obezbeđenom delu zatvora Grinsajd.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! i veverice
programme.desc: Kada Teodor pomisli da je pravi superheroj, Alvin i Sajmon će morati dobro da se potrude ne bi li ga ubedili da borbu protiv zločina prepusti profesionalcima.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! i veverice
programme.desc: Sajmona je mnogo sramota da poljubi koleginicu sa kojom glumi u predstavi. U trenutku očaja pristaje da dozvoli ALvinu da zamene identitete.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! i veverice
programme.desc: Pošto želi da pruđi Dejvu prekopotrebni odmor, Alvin tajno odlučuje da iznajmi njihovu kuću u zamenu za kuću na Havajima. Jedini problem je što gosti dolaze ranije dok je Dejv još kod kuće.

programme.title: Garfild
programme.desc: Garfild je lenji, sebični, gojazni narandžasti mačak čiji omiljeni hobiji su: izležavanje, spavanje, gledanje televizije, proždiranje pice i zabavljanje... Ali on ima veliko srce i, mada prvo obično pokaže svoju sebičnu stranu, zahvaljujući svojoj genijalnosti, uspeva da spasi stvar, pa čak i da izbavi Odija iz nevolje.

programme.title: Garfild
programme.desc: Vlasnik knjižare Rupert pozvao je Džona Arbakla da daje autograme, ali... Ne pojavljuje se nijedan čitalac i niko nije došao da se divi posebnom izdanju stripa o Ultramoćnom Tipu u izlogu knjižare. Utučeni Rupert moraće da zatvori knjižaru. Na njegovu sreću, Garfild se priključuje sa svojom idejom: u knjižari prosto mora da se pojavi superheroj. Možda onaj najherojskiji među njima? Osvetnik sa plaštom dolazi da spasi Ruperta... i rešava zagonetku.

programme.title: Kruds - Porodično Stablo
programme.desc: Rešena da dokaže Houp da jednako dobro kuva, Uga odlučuje da spremi obrok koji će zadiviti stanovnike farme. Ali kad Uga shvati da je van elementa, obraća se za pomoć boks majmunima.

programme.title: Kruds - Porodično Stablo
programme.desc: Kada Houp dozvoli Don da pozajmi njenu omiljenu narukvicu, Don je rešena da dokaže da je odgovorna. Ali kada narukvica slučajno završi u jeguljorlovom gnezdu, Don, Ip i Gaj moraju da vrate narukvicu pre nego što Houp sazna za to.

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Marina pogrešno veruje da roditelji više vole Vendi i odlučuje da to promeni! Ali kad pokuša da ugodi roditeljima, upada u još veću nevolju. Srećom, Vendi je tu da spreči svaku katastrofu. Ali Vendi ne može da pazi na Marinu u svakom trenutku i Marina na kraju završava kažnjena. Da bi se osvetila, mala napast uvaljuje i Vendi u nevolju i obe bivaju zatvorene u svojim sobama! Izjednačeno jes! Sad samo treba da nađu način da se izvuku iz kazne..

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Postoji Dan majki i Dan očeva, ali šta je sa sestrama? Marina objavljuje da je danas Dan sestara i sprema poklon za Vendi. Ali njena sestra samo želi da je ostave na miru! Ako je tako, Marina će joj dati prostora... I pobrinuće se za to da Vendi stvarno bude sama ceo dan! Grr... Da bi joj se osvetila, Vendi odlučuje da pobedi Marinu njenim oružjem.

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Marina želi da natera Vendi i Maksansa da prođu kroz pet ključnih faza za parove, o kojima je čitala u časopisu o popularnoj psihologiji, ali ubrzano. Posle jedne baš užasne svađe, otkrivanja intimne tajne, zajedničkog života i rođenja bebe, Vendi i Maksans moraju da postanu stari par, baš kao mama i tata! Onda neće zuriti jedno u drugo po ceo dan i Vendi će konačno moći da provede vreme sa svojom sestrom.

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Sestre se dive muralu koji su Dje i Balu naslikali u parku i žele da naslikaju jedan još veći negde drugde u gradu. Vendi sanja o muralu u čast njene omiljene grupe, Vanda-liza, dok Marina želi nešto sa Super Piju-Pijuom, svojim večnim junakom! Devojke započinju kampanju da ubede ljude da glasaju za njihovu ideju... Konkurencija je žestoka.

programme.title: Zoro
programme.desc: Naša nova serija predstavlja tinejdžera Don Dijega, koji se suočava sa najvećim životnim izazovom boreći se za pravdu protiv brojnih bezobzirnih tirana! Tako se rađa najpoznatiji maskirani heroj. Zoro jednostavno ismeva svoje protivnike učeći ih lekciji i potpisuje svoja dela zaštitnim znakom "Z".

programme.title: Zoro
programme.desc: Naša nova serija predstavlja tinejdžera Don Dijega, koji se suočava sa najvećim životnim izazovom boreći se za pravdu protiv brojnih bezobzirnih tirana! Tako se rađa najpoznatiji maskirani heroj. Zoro jednostavno ismeva svoje protivnike učeći ih lekciji i potpisuje svoja dela zaštitnim znakom "Z".

programme.title: Nekada Davno - Predmeti
programme.desc: Sa radnicima poput Minusa i Krastija u blizini, Maestru je teško da nam priča o klaviru. Srećom, Piter i Pjeret su tu da pomognu i pokažu kako se ovaj veličanstveni polifoni žičani instrument razvio... Čekajte, rekli ste polifonični? Šta to znači? Sačekajte, Maestro će objasniti.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! i veverice
programme.desc: Kada jedan incident natera Sakmona da nosi svoje stare naočare, postaće meta školskog siledžije. Pošto ne želi da bude žrtva, Sajmon pravi robota zaštitnika, koji će mu pomoći da se suprotstavi siledžijama.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! i veverice
programme.desc: Kad Alvin zatekne Sajmona kako rešava test ličnosti da bi pronašao svoju srodnu dušu, odlučuje da i sam uradi taj test da bi dokazao koliko je besmislen. Ali kad test pokaže da je njegova srodna duša Britani, postaće dobar i uglađen momak.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! i veverice
programme.desc: Kada se Dejv prehladi, Alvin se nudi da preuzme njegove dužnosti u kući. Ali ubrzo će otkriti da je roditeljstvo mnogo teže nego što je on mislio.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! i veverice
programme.desc: Teodor očajnički želi da glumi čudovište u predstavi, pa Alvin rešava da mu pokaže kako da stvarno uplaši ljude. Međutim, Alvin će ga toliko uplašiti da će se Teodor ukočiti od straha. Da li će se Teodor otkočiti pre velike audicije.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! i veverice
programme.desc: Alvin će se toliko zaljubiti u devojčicu iz škole da će pristati da joj pričuva pticu. Ali kad bude izgovorio nešto loše, zabrinuće se da ptica možda to ne ponovi pred Minom. Mora da nađe način da spreči pticu da ne blebeće.

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Noć je. Sestre drhte od straha dok gledaju Apokalipsu 2000. godine, stari film strave sa zombijima. Odjednom nestaje struje. Kuća i čitav komšiluk su u mraku. Marina i Vendi baš i nisu hrabre, naročito pošto njihovi roditelji nisu tu... Nasmrt su preplašene i ujedinjene u strahu, dok se spremaju da odbiju napad zombija na kuću..

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Marina nalazi mačku na ulici i donosi je kući ne rekavši roditeljima. Uspeva čak i da ubedi stariju sestru da joj pomogne da sakrije mače... Ali Vendi otkriva da je Maksans alergičan na mačju dlaku. Nema šanse da drže mačku u kući! Međutim, Marina neće tako lako odustati.

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Marina odgovara tačno na sva pitanja u radio-kvizu... Naravno da je zaboravila da kaže Vendi da je kviz emitovan prethodnog dana i da je već čula odgovore... Vendi je zadivljena sestrinom novootkrivenom pameću. Trebalo bi da Marina bude srećna što joj se Vendi divi.

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Marina i Vendi se ponovo svađaju i trče da se tužakaju roditeljima. Načule su razgovor koji ih je užasnuo: njihovi roditelji se razvode! A nameravaju da razdvoje i devojčice. Jedna će živeti sa majkom, druga sa ocem.

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Vendi stalno kija, čak se i ospe kad je Marina u blizini... Da li je moguće da je alergična na malu napast? Vendi potvrđuje: ima "mlađisestritis" alergiju koju tinejdžerke dobiju kad su njihove sestre previše naporne. To znači... da Marina nikad više ne može da se igra sa svojom sestrom.

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Nata se stalno hvali svojim starijim bratom. Marinu to nervira i zato izmišlja da je njena sestra stručnjak za kung-fu! Šta?! Vendi ne može da veruje. Trenirala je samo šest meseci, i to kad je bila mala! Ništa strašno: Marina će biti njen trener, a pošto je Vendi zaista nadarena, sve će biti u redu.

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Dve sestre. Dve eksplozivne ličnosti. Pod jednim krovom. Sestrej e komedija o svakodnevnom životu dve sestre, od kojih jedna ima 7, a druga 13 godina. Marin je i dalje dete, dok njena starija sestra Vendi ulazi u tinejdžerske godine. Obe su temperamentne, veoma različite ličnosti i obožavaju se! Marin je naivna, simpatična, veoma hiperaktivna i veoma napadna. Ona uvek smišlja lude ideje da bi privukla pažnju svoje sestre, dok Vendi više teži životu odrasle osobe. Ova komedija karaktera govori o bratstvu/sestrinstvu.

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Petak je trinaesti i Marina je slomila ogledalo... To znači godine loše sreće! Da bi razbila kletvu, ona se drži Vendi i njene deteline sa četiri lista. Ali Vendi je dosta toga i kida detelinu da bi joj se Marina sklonila s puta.

programme.title: Džeronimo Stilton
programme.desc: Džeronimo je gospodin miš koji, pored toga što voli svoj posao i svoju porodicu, obožava da skuplja korice starog sira iz osamnaestog veka. Mrzi da putuje jer mu svako putovanje, bilo brodom, kolima ili avionom, izaziva mučninu... Ali ga, bez obzira na to, porodica uvlači u najneverovatnije pustolovine svuda po svetu.
